name: B10-0123/2025 (ECR) – Continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on continuing detention and risk of the death penalty for individuals in Nigeria charged with blasphemy, notably the case of Yahaya Sharif-Aminu
part_text:
The European Parliament is calling on Nigeria to free Yahaya Sharif-Aminu, a singer held since 2020 on blasphemy charges that can lead to death, and to drop the charges against him. It also asks for the release of three other people jailed on similar charges. It says Nigeria's blasphemy laws break its own constitution and international human rights promises, and urges Nigeria to scrap these laws and stop using the death penalty for blasphemy.

- The report only states the Parliament's opinion; no law changes.
- It concerns Yahaya Sharif-Aminu and three other jailed Nigerians.
- Next, the Parliament sends its request to Nigeria's parliament and government.
